# British Scholars

> British Scholars is a private tutor network helping families in Dubai and across the UAE find carefully selected British-qualified tutors for GCSE, IGCSE, A Level and International Baccalaureate (IB) support.

British Scholars provides personal tutor matching rather than an open marketplace. Families submit a free enquiry with the subject, curriculum, level, location and preferred tuition format. Tutor qualifications, identity and relevant teaching experience are reviewed before recommendations are made.

## Entity and trust

- [About British Scholars](https://britishscholars.ae/about-british-scholars): Clear factual overview of the organisation, service area, curricula, subjects, matching model and contact details.
- [How We Verify Tutors](https://britishscholars.ae/how-we-verify-tutors): How British Scholars reviews tutor qualifications, identity and teaching experience.
- [Choosing a Private Tutor in Dubai](https://britishscholars.ae/choosing-a-private-tutor-dubai): Parent guidance on choosing suitable private tuition.
- [British Tutors in Dubai](https://britishscholars.ae/british-tutors-dubai): Parent-focused guidance on qualifications, curriculum fit, rapport and what good tutoring should feel like.

## Parent decision guides

- [IB vs A Level in Dubai](https://britishscholars.ae/ib-vs-a-level-dubai): A balanced guide to breadth, depth, workload, subject choice and student fit.
- [Private Tutor Cost in Dubai](https://britishscholars.ae/private-tutor-cost-dubai): A transparent guide to the factors behind tutoring prices and how parents can judge value.
- [UAE Tutor Qualification and Safeguarding Checklist](https://britishscholars.ae/tutor-safeguarding-checklist-uae): A free 12-point parent resource covering identity, current permit requirements, qualifications, safeguarding, privacy, fees and progress.

## Service area

British Scholars serves families in Dubai and across the United Arab Emirates. Tuition may be requested online, in person, or in a flexible format, subject to tutor availability.
